item.title: Jersey’s population estimated to top 104,000 – but growth slowing
item.description: THERE were an estimated 104,540 people living in Jersey at the end of 2024 – an increase of 510 from the previous year, marking the third year in a row that had seen a rise in population. However, the government’s latest population report – released today – also showed that the rate of growth was slowing. item.title: Work on St Catherine’s breakwater to begin next month
item.description: ST Catherine’s breakwater is to undergo ground investigation work next month, as engineers prepare to drill into its ageing structure to help guide future repairs. As part of the project, four boreholes will be drilled on the southern slipway and ten trial pits across the wider site will be excavated.
